subject: Acme Robotics - private offer: term length & monthly billing request
messages:
From: Rebecca Shaw <procurement@acmerobotics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mika Tanaka <mika@acmerobotics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer for Acme Robotics - term preference

Hi Irene / Jordan,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — the engineering team is excited to start. Before we sign, procurement has two constraints we need you to confirm:

1) Term: Can we do a 6-month private offer (pilot) rather than a 12-month annual commitment?
2) Billing cadence: We need monthly billing on actual usage (invoice) instead of an annual prepaid charge.
3) Compliance evidence: our security team needs a SOC 2 snapshot and any recent penetration test summary before CFO signs.

If those three items are acceptable, I can route to our CFO (Lena) and legal for a rapid PO. Please confirm and share any required docs/forms and a DocuSign link for the PO.

Attachments: none

Best,
Rebecca
Procurement Manager
Acme Robotics

---
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Shaw <procurement@acmerobotics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer for Acme Robotics - term preference

Rebecca — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers and next steps below: 

1) Term: We generally offer private offers at annual commitment, but we can structure a timeboxed 6-month pilot as a Private Offer with limited entitlements. That will require Finance signoff on activation windows and an explicit renewal/opt-in clause.

2) Billing cadence: Monthly invoicing on usage is possible for pilots but we need to lock payment terms (Net30/Net45) and manual invoicing creates extra ops work. If monthly billing is a hard requirement, expect a 10–20% uplift on unit pricing to offset risk (we can propose 15%).

3) Compliance evidence: attaching a recent SOC 2 snapshot and our standard security overview. Mika — feel free to review and confirm if this meets Acme's needs.

Action items:
- I attached pricing_model_acmerobotics.xlsx (preliminary pricing with 15% monthly uplift option).
- Jordan, can you open a HubSpot task and include Acme's legal & procurement PDFs? Link: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/2647/deals/DEAL-2026-ACME-137
- Karthik, please advise if we should approve the 6-month concession and pricing uplift.

Irene Choi
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_model_acmerobotics.xlsx, SOC2_snapshot_Acme.pdf

To: Rebecca Shaw <procurement@acmerobotics.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer for Acme Robotics - term preference

Rebecca — appreciate the clarity. Two quick data points from our side: 

- We can do the 6-month pilot as Irene outlined. If Acme prefers monthly invoicing, we'll need the PO to include an explicit activation/termination date and a payment schedule.
- I'd like to lock the pricing in HubSpot once we agree (see linked quote). ETA to produce DocuSign-ready PO: 2 business days after we agree terms.

Rebecca, can you confirm Lena (CFO) will accept SOC2 snapshot (attached earlier) in lieu of the full report? If yes, I'll prepare the PO and send DocuSign link.

HubSpot quote: https://hubspot.redwood/quotes/qt-ACME-137

-Jordan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Private offer for Acme Robotics - term preference (internal)

Internal only — guidance:

I. Approve 6-month pilot under these guardrails:
  - Monthly invoicing allowed with Net30.
  - 15% uplift on the per-token/per-embedding unit price to offset billing & churn risk.
  - Auto-expiry clause at 6 months unless customer signs opt-in to convert to annual within 30 days of pilot end.
II. Escrow/finance: include a clause that any unpaid invoices after 45 days move to collections; Finance to approve with a one-time activation fee if legal requests.
III. Security: provide SOC2 snapshot + attestation letter; if Mika says it's insufficient, escalate to CS security for a redline.

Irene — approve this path to move quickly. Jordan — you can prep the DocuSign PO with the uplift and clause language; attach mop_escrow_clause.docx as reference.

Karthik Iyer
GM, Sales Operations

Attachments: mop_escrow_clause.docx

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmerobotics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rebecca Shaw <procurement@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Mika Tanaka <mika@acmerobotics.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer for Acme Robotics - term preference

Team — thanks for the fast responses. After review with procurement and security: 

- SOC2 snapshot + attestation from Redwood's security team is acceptable for the pilot. Mika will follow up on any clarifying questions.
- Acme will accept a 6-month pilot with monthly invoicing, Net30 payment, provided the DocuSign PO includes the auto-expiry clause and the uplifted pricing noted.

Please send the DocuSign PO and a final invoice schedule. Once I have that we'll issue the PO and routing to accounting.

Lena Ortiz
CFO, Acme Robotics

Attachments: none
